agenda_text:
THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Hilda Delgado, Vice Chair  Eva Melgarejo, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Alejandra Ramirez, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director  Elwood Sides, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MONICA.JAIME@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54915  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54916  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of August 21, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54917  Recommendation to approve a total loan of $5,000,000, to include $1,500,000 in
  Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) funds and $3,500,000 in Community
  Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds, to Century Affordable Development, Inc.
  (Century) for the acquisition of the property located at 1401 Long Beach Blvd;

  Authorize the President to negotiate an Acquisition Loan Agreement with Century;
  and

  Authorize the President to execute any and all documents necessary to implement
  the Loan Agreement and the project.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54918  Recommendation to approve the selection of NuPhilly Community Development
  Corporation (NuPhilly) for an award of Community Housing Development
  Organization (CHDO) funds in the amount of up to $700,000; and

  Authorize the President or designee to enter into an Agreement to Negotiate

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

  Exclusively with NuPhilly for the adaptive reuse development of affordable rental
  housing units.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54919  Recommendation to approve the selection of Linc Housing Corporation (Linc) for an
  award of HOME funds in the amount of up to $5,000,000; and

  Authorize the President or designee to enter into an Agreement to Negotiate
  Exclusively with Linc for new construction of affordable rental housing units.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Monica Jaime, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.
